history.summary: Local Ganesha temple at Vishwakarma Society, Vivekanand Wadi, 80 Feet Road, Anand (pin 388001/388120). Documented only through map/directory listings and Google reviews (4.8, ~390 reviews) - no authoritative written history found. One Google review claims a ~500-year-old murti was found beneath the temple; single-review claim, unverified. Opening hours and festivals are not published online. Identity as the CSV row's referent is plausible but weakly sourced.

name: Shri Siddhivinayak Mandir
town_description: Anand is a city in central Gujarat, known as the 'Milk Capital of India' as the home of the Amul dairy cooperative and the Anand Agricultural University. It is a commercial hub of the Charotar region between Ahmedabad and Vadodara.

travel.road: Within Anand city, on 80 Feet Road, Vivekanand Wadi
